news.headline: Analysts Raise Price Targets on Lexeo Therapeutics Following Q2 Results
news.summary: In the wake of Q2 2026 results, RBC Capital lifted its price target on Lexeo to $24 from $22 while keeping an Outperform rating, and Chardan Capital raised its target to $17 from $15 with a Buy rating, citing progress across the LX2006 and LX2020 gene-therapy programs.

news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Operational Highlights
news.summary: Lexeo highlighted the initiation of SUNRISE-FA2, the pivotal trial for LX2006 in Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy, and reiterated a topline data readout expected in the second half of 2027 with a targeted BLA submission under the accelerated approval pathway in 1H 2028.

news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ:LXEO) Given Average Rating of "Buy" by Brokerages
news.summary: Nine covering analysts hold a consensus "Buy" rating on LXEO with an average twelve-month price target of about $18.75, reflecting building Street confidence in the gene-therapy pipeline heading into the Q2 print.

news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics Receives FDA Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) Designation for LX2020 for PKP2 Arrhythmogenic Cardiomyopathy
news.summary: The FDA granted RMAT status to LX2020, an AAVrh10 gene therapy for PKP2-associated arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy, based on positive interim data from the ongoing HEROIC-PKP2 Phase I/II trial, adding to the program's existing Orphan Drug and Fast Track designations.

news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics (NASDAQ:LXEO) Raised to "Strong-Buy" at Chardan Capital
news.summary: Chardan Capital upgraded Lexeo Therapeutics from Buy to Strong-Buy, becoming one of two brokerages with the firm's top rating on the stock ahead of the company's Q2 earnings report.

news.headline: Louis Edward Tamayo Sells 4,641 Shares of Lexeo Therapeutics (NASDAQ:LXEO) Stock
news.summary: Lexeo's CFO sold 4,641 shares at a weighted-average price of $4.49 on July 1, 2026, in a routine tax-withholding transaction tied to the vesting of performance RSUs, leaving him with 97,024 shares directly held.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 Earnings Conference Call
catalysts.detail: Management hosts a conference call/webcast at 9:30 AM ET to discuss Q2 2026 results and pipeline progress in detail.

catalysts.label: SUNRISE-FA2 Topline Data (LX2006)
catalysts.detail: Topline data from the pivotal SUNRISE-FA2 trial in Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy, intended to support a BLA filing under the accelerated approval pathway.

catalysts.label: LX2006 BLA Submission
catalysts.detail: Company is targeting submission of a Biologics License Application to the FDA for LX2006 under the accelerated approval pathway.

catalysts.label: HEROIC-PKP2 Follow-up Data and Registrational Path for LX2020
catalysts.detail: Following the August 2026 RMAT designation, further interim/updated data from the HEROIC-PKP2 Phase I/II trial and next steps in FDA registrational discussions for LX2020 in PKP2-ACM are anticipated.

pulse: Lexeo has had a catalyst-dense stretch in early August 2026: it initiated the pivotal SUNRISE-FA2 trial for LX2006 in Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy and secured FDA RMAT designation for LX2020 in PKP2-associated arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy, both reinforced by the Q2 2026 earnings update. Sell-side sentiment has turned notably more bullish, with Chardan's Strong-Buy upgrade, a consensus Buy rating (~$18.75 average target), and post-earnings price-target hikes from RBC and Chardan. The next major test is execution — SUNRISE-FA2 topline data isn't expected until 2H 2027, with a targeted 1H 2028 BLA filing for LX2006, while LX2020's path forward hinges on follow-up HEROIC-PKP2 data and FDA registrational discussions.
